taskAPIProbe.scope: Exact pipe-controlled, generation-bound unreaped Python children only.
taskAPIProbe.monitoring: Children inherit the outer monitored process group; only exact Popen children are signalled or reaped. Outer Runner owns group cleanup and resource monitoring.

taskAPIProbe.retention: Counts plus first controlled/unavailable/recheck evidence, latest sixteen samples/queries and separate stopping sample.
taskAPIProbe.deadlineLimit: Synchronous native calls are not interrupted by the inner clock. The outer Runner and job deadline remain the hard execution boundary.

readOnlyImageProbe.rawBackingControl: Open and close O_RDWR with zero bytes written; no second read-write attachment.
controls: Baseline child writes through a held writable descriptor.
Shared mapping writes after closing the original descriptor.
Exact owned children are released/reaped before read-only reattachment.
Late path opening, new-file creation and rename must return EROFS.
Writable shared mapping from a read-only descriptor must be denied; private mapping must leave file bytes unchanged.
readOnlyImageProbe.binding: Private backing dev/inode/UID/link-count, canonical mount, hdiutil entities, device set and volume UUID are checked before relevant operations. Unbound or ambiguous devices are never detached.
readOnlyImageProbe.cleanup: Each exact child cleanup and non-force owned-image detach have bounded attempts and safe failure detail. Original primary failure remains separate; cleanup-only failure sets a fixed firstFailure.
readOnlyImageProbe.heldDetachResult: Nonzero plus a still-bound writable attachment is an observed refusal, not proof of EBUSY. Successful held detach does not prove old-handle revocation.
readOnlyImageProbe.qualification: NO_GO for every observation outcome; read-only mount success does not establish same-UID backing/remount immutability or a complete frozen source/tools/SDK/payload view.
